description: This file defines the 'Matrix' class which provides a comprehensive implementation for matrix operations, including creation, validation, subsetting, and algebraic computations such as determinant, inverse, and decomposition-based solutions. It also supports property access and method calls for advanced matrix methods.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical matrix, supporting various matrix operations, properties, validation, and decomposition-based solving methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matrix from a 2D array, setting internal grid, rows, and columns.

methods.name: buildFromArray
methods.description: Internal method to build matrix grid structure from an array, updating row and column counts.

methods.name: validateRow
methods.description: Static method to validate that a row index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateColumn
methods.description: Static method to validate that a column index is a positive integer.

methods.name: validateRowInRange
methods.description: Validates that a given row index falls within the matrix's row range.

methods.name: validateColumnInRange
methods.description: Validates that a given column index falls within the matrix's column range.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns a new Matrix object with a subset of rows, starting at a specified row.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns a new Matrix with a subset of columns, starting at a specified column.

methods.name: dropRows
methods.description: Returns a new Matrix with specified rows dropped.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Returns a new Matrix with specified columns dropped.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific cell identified by row and column numbers.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Generator yielding each row of the matrix as a vector.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Generator yielding each column of the matrix as a vector.

methods.name: isSquare
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is square (rows == columns).

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Checks if the matrix is a vector (single row or column).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the internal grid as a 2D array.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves linear systems A*X=B, using LU decomposition if square, QR otherwise.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Magic method to access read-only properties like rows and columns.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle dynamic method calls for matrix operations and functions.
